Being in a different environment can reduce stress levels and improve sleep quality. The relaxation and change in routine can help you sleep better and wake up feeling more refreshed.

Vacations are a form of self-care, allowing you to prioritize your well-being and happiness. They offer the opportunity to engage in activities that bring you joy and relaxation.
